prohibited_generalizations: Do not transfer coach scores, metric directions, hierarchy depth, class weights, media overlap, or time trends without reconstructing the receiving roster and measurement contract.
Do not call top-five membership overlap exact ranking accuracy, and do not compare composite scores across sports until their scales and criteria are demonstrably commensurate.

features.quantitative_role: bind roster size, metric direction, normalized value, dispersion, matrix entry, local weight, class weight, CIC, composite score, rank, perturbation, or overlap statistic to its declared role
